tag_code.title: Tag code
tag_code.x-seam-help: x-seam-input-mask: AA-9999. Letters are upper-cased, digits only where a 9 is, and the dash is inserted for you. The mask is also the placeholder, and its length is the maxlength.

phone.title: Phone
phone.x-seam-help: The tel widget (numeric keyboard on phones) with a digits-only mask.

contact_email.title: Contact email
contact_email.x-seam-help: The email widget: native syntax validation in the browser, checked again on the server.

new_password.title: Password
new_password.x-seam-help: x-seam-autocomplete: new-password. The widget never writes a stored value into the page, so the field always renders empty.

next_service.title: Next service
next_service.x-seam-help: Local date and time in one control.

load_capacity.title: Load capacity
load_capacity.x-seam-help: x-seam-unit: kg. The unit is a fixed suffix after the field; it is not part of the posted value.

operating_temp.title: Operating temperature
operating_temp.x-seam-help: The same modifier with another unit.

unit_price.title: Unit price
unit_price.x-seam-help: decimalScale 2: the browser pattern allows at most two decimals, and the value travels as text, byte for byte, so nothing is lost to floating point.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.x-seam-help: The native colour picker; it posts a hex code and starts at #6366f1.

cert_required.title: Certificate required
cert_required.x-seam-help: The checkbox widget: a ticked box posts a value, an unticked one posts nothing. Tick it to reveal Certificate number.

cert_number.title: Certificate number
cert_number.x-seam-help: x-seam-visible-when on a boolean: shown only while the checkbox above is ticked.

notify_owner.title: Notify the owner
notify_owner.x-seam-help: The toggle widget: it posts exactly like a checkbox, drawn as a switch.

inspector_note.title: Inspector note (tooltip help)
inspector_note.x-seam-help: x-seam-help-style: tooltip puts this text behind a small help icon instead of under the field.
